✨ Moody Krea2 Simple Workflow is Here! 🎉

If you've used myZimageorF2K Simple Workflow, this one will feel very familiar. It's atext-to-image workflowspecifically tuned forKrea2and optimized forMoody Krea2 models.

🚀 Features

  • ⚡ Dual KSampler setup

    • 1️⃣ First sampler for fast previews

    • 2️⃣ Second sampler for upscaling and adding fine details

  • 🧩 VRAM-friendly Tiled Upscalefor users with smaller GPUs

  • 🌱 OptionalSeedVR2 Upscalerfor the final enhancement

  • 🎨 Two-stage inpaint detailing

  • 📦 Automatic BBox detector inpainting

  • ✍️ Manual masked inpaintingfor precise edits

Everything is packed into a single workflow to give you theultimate Krea2 text-to-image experiencewith Moody models.

❤️ Enjoy, and have fun creating!
